title: pr-review-copilot: move review state out of the plugin install dir
description: review-diff, team-conventions, and review-history read and write data/conventions.md and data/review-history.json inside the plugin directory. Marketplace installs live in the plugin cache and each version gets its own cache directory, so every release orphans the user conventions and history; release-please will bump 0.1.0 to 0.2.0 on the first feat commit. The skills locate the files as relative to this plugin root, which Claude cannot resolve reliably from a SKILL.md body. Team conventions belong in the reviewed repo (for example a committed .claude/pr-review-conventions.md); history in project-local storage or ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, which is documented for hooks/MCP/LSP but not for SKILL.md substitution.
notes: Baseline (pre-edit skills, simulated cache install at .../cache/pr-review-copilot/0.1.0): both team-conventions and review-history targeted <cache>/0.1.0/data/*, the versioned cache dir; a local hook blocked both writes. Fix: conventions -> committed .claude/pr-review-conventions.md seeded from skills/team-conventions/references/conventions-template.md; history -> .claude/pr-review-history.local.json with a git check-ignore warning; plugin data/ removed. Verification runs: sim-green-1 (no .gitignore) and sim-green-2 (.gitignore has .claude/*.local.json).
close_reason: State moved to the project: committed .claude/pr-review-conventions.md (seeded from skills/team-conventions/references/conventions-template.md) and .claude/pr-review-history.local.json with a git check-ignore warning; plugin data/ removed. Baseline wrote to the versioned cache dir; both verification runs resolved to project/.claude, left the plugin cache untouched, and hit the correct gitignore branch (warn on exit 1, silent on exit 0). Content writes in the sandbox were blocked by the dotfiles tmp/ hook, not by the skills.

title: decide: protect main so the CI gate is required
description: main has no branch protection (gh api .../branches/main/protection returns 404), so the Lint and test and Commit messages checks are advisory and a red PR can still merge. This is a repository setting, not a file, so it needs the owner's call: required checks, whether admins are exempt, and how release-please PRs get through.
acceptance_criteria: Branch protection or a ruleset on main requires both CI checks, or the decision not to is recorded.

title: test: exercise the plugin hook scripts
description: Four shell hooks ship (dotfiles: enforce-source-only.sh, chezmoi-diff-reminder.sh; mise: session-start-check.sh; ruby-rails: check-ruby-lsp.sh). lint:shell only runs shfmt for formatting; nothing executes them and shellcheck is not run. enforce-source-only.sh blocks edits, so a bug there obstructs users directly.
acceptance_criteria: shellcheck runs in lint; enforce-source-only.sh has tests feeding representative hook JSON and asserting allow/block; the others have at least a smoke test.

title: test: add trigger evals for overlapping skills
description: No plugin has evals, so nothing detects a skill description drifting so it stops triggering, or starts stealing requests from a neighbor. With 63 skills, overlap is likely. Start with the plugins whose descriptions overlap most: git-workflow, pr-review-copilot, debug-session-tracker. Use claude plugin eval.
acceptance_criteria: Eval suites exist for git-workflow, pr-review-copilot, and debug-session-tracker covering should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts; how to run them is documented.

title: test: every hook script referenced from hooks.json exists and is executable
description: A hooks.json pointing at a missing or non-executable script fails at runtime in the user's session, not in CI. A one-off check on 2026-10-09 found all pass. Handle both the "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"/... and bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/... command forms. Spec rank 4.
acceptance_criteria: Each script path referenced from a plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json resolves to a file; scripts invoked directly (not via bash) are executable.

title: test: SKILL.md frontmatter parses with a matching name and description
description: A skill with missing or mismatched frontmatter fails to load or never triggers. A one-off check on 2026-10-09 found all skills pass, so this only locks it in. Spec rank 3.
acceptance_criteria: Every plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md has parseable frontmatter, name equal to its directory, and a non-empty description.

title: test: plugin.json has required fields and a matching name
description: Nothing validates plugin.json beyond version/description agreement. The checklist requires name, description, version, license (BlueOak-1.0.0), and author; name must match the containing directory. Spec rank 2.
acceptance_criteria: Each published plugin.json is checked for the required fields, license BlueOak-1.0.0, and name equal to its directory.

title: test: every plugin directory is published in marketplace.json
description: The suite checks listed-implies-exists but never exists-implies-listed. Adding plugins/<name>/ and forgetting the marketplace.json entry is silent today. example-plugin is unpublished on purpose and must be the explicit exception. Spec rank 1.
acceptance_criteria: A test fails if a directory under plugins/ (other than an explicit allowlist containing example-plugin) has no marketplace.json entry; passes on main today.

title: test: structural guards for plugins
description: The CI spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-marketplace-ci-design.md, 'Follow-up: shoring up the suite') ranked five structural tests to add once CI existed. They were never filed because bd was blocked by pending migrations at the time. Each guards a failure that is silent today. Most currently pass, so each test is cheap and catches future drift.

title: pr-review-copilot: close review-diff workflow gaps
description: (1) review-diff checks review-history but no step appends findings, so recurrence detection never gets data unless the user asks separately. (2) Inputs name web_fetch (the Claude Code tool is WebFetch) and MCP connectors but not gh pr diff / gh pr view or a local git diff, which is how the rest of this marketplace reaches GitHub. (3) Step 7 delivers as a markdown artifact, a claude.ai idiom; choose the Artifact tool, a file, or inline. (4) The worked example lists finding #3 in the table with no detail section, breaking the template rule, and labels missing tests on a new endpoint as Nit despite the severity definitions.

title: Register pr-review-copilot in marketplace.json, release-please, and root README
description: New plugin plugins/pr-review-copilot is untracked and unregistered. Audit it against plugins/meta/references/marketplace-checklist.md, then add it to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, release-please-config.json, .release-please-manifest.json, and the root README plugin list.
acceptance_criteria: bun test covers the new entry and passes; markdownlint, cspell, and biome are clean on the plugin and registration files
close_reason: Registered in marketplace.json, release-please config and manifest (0.1.0), and root README; bun test 230 pass, lint clean, claude plugin validate passes. Open design findings filed as marketplace-a8p, marketplace-yuo, marketplace-iqy.

title: chore: make .editorconfig agree with biome on tabs
description: .editorconfig declares indent_style = space, but biome.json sets tabs and every JSON, TS, and shell file is tab-indented. Editors honoring editorconfig fight the formatter. Deferred from the CI spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-marketplace-ci-design.md). Markdown and YAML may need to stay spaces; check before changing globally.
acceptance_criteria: .editorconfig matches the indentation biome, shfmt -i 0, and markdownlint actually enforce per file type.

title: ci: pin release-please-action to a commit digest
description: release.yml uses google-github-actions/release-please-action@v4 while every other action is SHA-pinned with a version comment, per renovate's helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests. Deferred from the CI spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-marketplace-ci-design.md). workflow-integrity.test.ts's pinning test may need to cover release.yml too.
acceptance_criteria: release.yml pins the action to a SHA with a # vX.Y.Z comment, and the pinning test covers every workflow file.

title: test: relative markdown links in plugins resolve
description: Skills link to their references/ files; a renamed file breaks the link silently. A one-off check on 2026-10-09 found one broken link: plugins/ruby-rails/skills/generating-rbs/references/rbs_examples/stdlib/STRUCTURE.md -> coverage/. Decide whether that corpus is upstream-verbatim (exempt it, as markdown-integrity.test.ts does) or fix the link. Skip links inside code fences. Spec rank 5.
acceptance_criteria: A test fails on any unresolved relative link in authored plugin markdown; the STRUCTURE.md link is fixed or explicitly exempted.

title: meta: release-please packages are not sorted, contradicting the checklist
description: plugins/meta/references/marketplace-checklist.md tells authors to keep release-please-config.json packages sorted alphabetically by path, but the file isn't sorted (plugins/dotfiles precedes plugins/bun; plugins/git-workflow is last). Either sort the packages (and consider a test guarding the order, as test/marketplace-versions.test.ts does for versions) or drop the sorting item from the checklist.
close_reason: Sorted all three registration files and added a test guarding the order

title: meta: marketplace-checklist release-please snippet omits the marketplace.json extra-file
description: plugins/meta/references/marketplace-checklist.md tells authors to add a release-please package with only the plugin.json extra-file and a manifest entry of 1.0.0. test/marketplace-versions.test.ts also requires an extra-file targeting /.claude-plugin/marketplace.json with a name-filter jsonpath, and precedent (git-workflow, pr-review-copilot) seeds the manifest with the plugin.json version. Following the checklist as written fails the suite.

title: Verify beads durability
description: Smoke test for the durability policy.
close_reason: Smoke test passed: bd dolt push landed refs/dolt/data on origin.

title: chore: delete merged remote branches and auto-delete head branches
description: Merged branches linger on origin: chore/beads-durability, copilot/fix-check-pr-metadata-on-push, copilot/fix-release-cut-issue, feat/add-ci-gate, feat/add-debug-session-tracker, feat/pr-review-copilot-plugin. A stale feat/pr-review-copilot-plugin already caused a duplicate conflicting PR (#50). Enabling 'Automatically delete head branches' stops new ones accumulating. Branch deletion needs the owner to run it or allow it.
acceptance_criteria: The merged branches are gone from origin and the repo setting deletes head branches on merge.
